headline: Rushil Decor submits structural digital database filing to NSE
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Rushil Decor
summary: Rushil Decor has submitted its structural digital database compliance filing to the National Stock Exchange. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement under insider trading regulations. No financial results or material corporate actions were disclosed in the update. The announcement carries no immediate financial or operational impact for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no impact on stock price
